text:
mariana_cs: quick heads-up from last night's dry-run with AlderTech. Two key blockers: overlapping CIDR with their transit fabric (10.5.0.0/16) and they want BYOK with HSM attestation. Need triage before tomorrow's client demo. @sanjay_se @kyle_infra @audrey_security

sanjay_se: confirmed overlap. Our dev smoke VPC used 10.5.16.0/20. We can either renumber the smoke VPC to 10.50.0.0/16 or NAT egress via a translation subnet. Renumbering will disrupt some test routes.

kyle_infra: migration cost estimate: renumbering smoke takes ~6h with automation, NAT translation is faster (~90m) but requires adding a managed NAT and updating peering route policies. For demo I'd prefer NAT translation to avoid touching test fixtures.

mariana_cs: demo is priority — go NAT translation for now. Log migration plan for post-demo renumbering. :white_check_mark:

audrey_security: BYOK request: AlderTech insists on customer-supplied key material and HSM attestation PDF. That triggers a compliance task and our vendor KMS team needs the attestation file. Lead time ~5bd. Ask customer if AWS-KMS with cross-account role is acceptable as fallback.

victor_am: flagging potential renewal risk if BYOK not agreed within 72 hours. Please record decision deadline and fallback plan.

nate_obs: audit logs: AlderTech requires VPC flow + API audit forwarded to their SIEM via TLS with client cert. For week0 set sampling=100% and enable delivery retry policy (3x, 30s interval). I'll prepare the HEC endpoint whitelisting instructions.

DeployBot: DeployBot: dry-run aldertech-demo-01 started by mariana_cs  logs: https://ci.reddemo/aldertech/01

mariana_cs: action items recap:
- network: apply NAT translation for egress, document route policy change (owner: sanjay_se)
- infra: implement NAT and smoke routing, verify zero-downtime for demo (owner: kyle_infra)
- security: initiate BYOK feasibility + request HSM attestation PDF; prepare fallback AWS-KMS policy (owner: audrey_security)
- obs: configure SIEM TLS ingest + 100% sampling week0 + delivery retry config (owner: nate_obs)
- AM: set renewal watch if BYOK decision >72h (owner: victor_am)

sanjay_se: starting NAT translation change now, will post route diffs when done.

kyle_infra: NAT up, smoke routes updated, demo path shows green on internal checks. Running a quick curl against the SIEM endpoint to validate TLS.

audrey_security: emailed AlderTech for HSM attestation and BYOK confirmation. Also attached a permissive AWS-KMS cross-account policy to offer as a fallback.

nate_obs: SIEM TLS handshake validated, logs flowing to their collector (sample event id: EVT-9821). Set alert to notify if delivery backlog >1000 events.

victor_am: recorded decision deadline 72h from now in account health. If BYOK not confirmed we'll proceed with AWS-KMS fallback and note the mitigation in the renewal playbook.

mariana_cs: excellent. Keep this thread updated with any blockers. If BYOK gets accepted we need to kick off the provisioning runbook (which includes compliance sign-off). If we hit >3bd delay we escalate to exec sponsor. :rotating_light:
